Complying with Data Protection Regulations

Estimated reading: 2 minutes 763 views

Our Commitment to Your Privacy

At PropertyList.es, we are dedicated to ensuring that your personal and property information is handled with the utmost care and in full compliance with data protection regulations.

Our Compliance Measures:

  • Adherence to GDPR: We strictly follow the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), which sets the standard for data protection and privacy in the European Union.
  • Data Protection Act 2018: As part of our commitment, we comply with the UK’s Data Protection Act 2018, which complements GDPR and provides additional safeguards for your data.
  • Transparent Data Practices: We ensure that your data is processed fairly, lawfully, and transparently. We only collect and use data for specified, explicit purposes.
  • Data Minimisation: We adhere to the principle of data minimisation, ensuring that we only collect data that is adequate, relevant, and limited to what is necessary for our services.
  • User Rights: We respect your rights under data protection laws, including the right to access, update, erase, or object to the processing of your personal data.
  • Regular Audits and Assessments: We conduct regular audits and assessments to ensure our data protection practices are up to date and in line with regulatory requirements.

By implementing these comprehensive measures, we ensure that your data is protected and your privacy is respected. At PropertyList.es, your trust is our priority, and we are committed to maintaining a secure and compliant environment for all our users.

 

PLEAE NOTE:
PropertyList does not have access to any contacts, property documents, or pipeline info. This ensures that your information remains secure within your office. However, please be careful when deleting any items, as we are unable to retrieve deleted information either.
